headline: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of PI 2026- Special Committee Of Board Of Directors Held On 10 November 2026
body: PI 2026 - Special Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company (''Committee'') at its meeting held today i.e., 10 November 2026, has approved the issue of 5,74,25,740 Warrants to Bajaj Finserv Limited, Promoter and holding company, at an issue price of Rs. 1,010 per Warrant, for an amount aggregating to Rs. 57,99,99,97,400 in accordance with the Chapter V of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
exchangeCategory: Board Meeting / Outcome of Board Meeting

headline: Board Meeting Intimation for PI 2026-Special Committee Meeting Of Board Of Directors Of The Company For Determining The Price Of Warrants To Be Issued To Bajaj Finserv Ltd., Promoter And Holding Company

headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management
body: The Board of Directors at their meeting held today, i.e., 19 October 2026, approved the re-appointment of Prashant Verma as Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) as per RBI Guidelines, effective 1 February 2027, for a period of 3 years, subject to regulatory approvals, if any.

headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Issue of Securities
body: The Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held today, i.e., 19 October 2026, approved, inter alia, issue of 49,00,737 equity shares of face value of Re. 1 at the respective grant prices to the trustees of BFL Employee Welfare Trust under the BFL Employee Stock Option Scheme 2009.
